The 2027 Shingle Color of the Year, Summer Harvest, captures the beauty of late summer as it gently transitions into autumn. raw_blocks: Our global nonwovens business is dedicated to transforming four key markets - construction, flooring, interiors, and industrial - with differentiated solutions that enable a world of possibilities for architects, builders, and designers.
Glas-Powered Veils for Ceiling Tiles

Compared to traditional ceiling materials, GLAS- POWERED™ ceiling facers & backers enable higher performance standards. Whether you're building for a brighter, quieter office space or a mold conscious healthcare facility, each veil request is tailor-made to fit your needs.
Glas-Powered Facers for Insulated Roof Decks & Walls

Compared to traditional materials like paper faced insulation boards, Owens Corning GLAS- POWERED™ facers enable higher performance standards. Whether you're building for a more durable exterior, to extend the life of your roof deck, or for a moisture resistant building envelope, Owens Corning Glass Coated Facers (GCF) for polyisocyanurate (polyiso) insulated roof decks & walls are tailor-made to fit your needs.

Compared to traditional materials like paper faced gypsum board or OSB, Owens Corning GLAS- POWERED™ gypsum facers & backers enable higher performance standards. Designed to increase weatherability, mold & mildew resistance, impact resistance & dimensional stability.
A sustainable future is the whole world’s business. Our products are designed with a sustainable impact in mind, and our nonwoven veils are no exception.
They enable stronger, lighter, and more durable buildings, that are ready to meet the needs of a changing world.
WANT TO KNOW MORE? Talk to an Expert
Connect with one of our experts to learn more about our Glas- Powered™ Veils. From technical information to regional availability, we're always ready to answer your questions.
